name: The Things You Do For Love
source:
TO DATE OR TO ELIMINATE? 
THAT IS THE QUESTION.

You think you're in love. They make your heart skip a beat, your train of thought miss a stop, and your mind lose control. It feels so nice, and so you crave that. You crave them.

This is what love feel like, right? 

Play as a love-stuck romantic who is trying to understand these complicated feelings all while taking down the competition! Urgh, there's so much to do but so little time to do it as prom is in three days!

Stalk your crush? 

Eliminate a rival? 

Or, perhaps make a new friend along the way? 

Just go win love — no matter what, no matter how!

[From [url=https://miseri-accordion.itch.io/for-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
是约会，还是除掉对方？
这是个问题。

你觉得自己恋爱了。那个人让你心跳漏拍，思绪脱轨，大脑失控。这感觉太美妙了，所以你渴望这种感觉。你渴望那个人。

爱情就是这种感觉，对吧？

扮演一个被爱情冲昏头脑的浪漫主义者，一边试图理解这些复杂的感情，一边扫除竞争对手！唉，要做的事情这么多，时间却那么少，毕竟毕业舞会三天后就要举行了！

跟踪心上人？

除掉情敌？

还是，顺便交个新朋友？

去赢得爱情吧——无论代价，无论手段！

[摘自[url=https://miseri-accordion.itch.io/for-love]Itch.io[/url]]
